notes: SMC is a community college with no bachelor's in computer science; the AS Computer Science (2025-26 catalog) is used as the nearest equivalent. Required core: CS 3, CS 17, CS 42, CS 50, MATH 7, plus one concentration group (CS 20A + CS 52, or CS 20B + CS 55). CS 50 was taken as the first programming course (no prerequisite) and CS 52 as the next required programming course (CS 20A requires CS 52). The SMC Academic Senate Instructional Technology & AI committee was drafting tiered syllabus AI-policy guidance in 2025-26, but no CS syllabus was found.
